game_of_the_week.default_criteria: Pick the most compelling upcoming matchup based on records, standings position, and head-to-head history.

week_overrides.1: It's the season opener — prioritize a rematch of a playoff game from last year, or a clash between prior season champions. If neither of those are scheduled, then find the matchup that is the most consistent (close to split record, close average scores against each other, etc).
week_overrides.2: If any of the four highest scoring teams are facing each other, then highlight that game. If that doesn't occur, then check to see if the highest scoring team from week one is also playing someone who is 1-0. If that doesn't exist, then check to see if there are any matchups (regardless of record) that are a repeat of a playoff game or championship game from the previous season. If that doesn't exist, then pick the worst two 0-1 teams.
week_overrides.3: 1) A game between two teams ranked in the top 5 of the standings (season_standings_rank 1-5). If more than one qualifies, pick the pair with the highest combined season win percentage (wins / (wins + losses), both teams combined). 2) If none, a top-5 team (by standings) facing a possible upset: an opponent ranked outside the top 5 in the standings but in the top 6 of the league in points scored (rank all teams by season_points_avg).
week_overrides.4: 1) A game between two teams ranked in the top 6 of the standings (season_standings_rank 1-6). If more than one qualifies, pick the pair with the highest combined season win percentage (wins / (wins + losses), both teams combined). 2) If none, a game between two teams currently ranked in the bottom 4 of the standings. Focus on how important a win is to change their playoff odds. 3) If none, a top-5 team (by standings) facing a possible upset: an opponent ranked outside the top 5 in the standings but in the top 5 of the power rankings (rank all teams by season_power_score, highest first). 4) If none, a game between two teams that have the same record. If more than one qualifies, pick the pair with the highest combined points average (season_points_avg, both teams combined).

Focus on how important a win is so they can avoid last place. 3) If none, a game between two teams currently in the top 5 of the power rankings (rank all teams by season_power_score, highest first). 4) If none, a top-5 team (by standings) facing a possible upset: an opponent ranked outside the top 5 in the standings but in the top 5 of the power rankings. 5) If none, a game between two teams that have the same record. If more than one qualifies, pick the pair with the highest combined points average (season_points_avg, both teams combined).

week_overrides.12: Playoff push. 1) Pick a game that will have playoff implications: a matchup between two of the current top 6 ranked teams (by standings) that could have an impact on a team getting a top 2 playoff seed. 2) If none, look for matchups involving teams ranked 7-10 (by standings) and focus on how important a win could be for them to make a playoff run.
